title: Planetary Science and Astronomy, Minor (Eberly College of Science)
notes: 19cr bulletin exact match. Pairs name-for-name with the already-built Planetary Science and Astronomy major (code PLANET); minor code PSAMIN avoids colliding with the major's own code. Distinct from the already-built Astronomy and Astrophysics Minor (ASTROMIN) -- a different, real bulletin program with a different prescribed-course pair and elective pool, both offered by the same department. Prescribed: ASTRO 401 (4cr, needs one of ASTRO 1/5/6/10 plus MATH 140) + ASTRO 402W (3cr, prereq-free per astro_catalog.json). Additional Courses' 'select one' 3cr slot filled with ASTRO 1 (3cr, prereq-free) -- deliberately picked over the other four options since it also satisfies ASTRO 401's own prereq group AND is itself the shared prereq for all three ASTRO 120/130/140 electives used below, so one course clears every downstream gate at once. Additional Courses' 'select three' 9cr slot filled with ASTRO 120 + ASTRO 130 + ASTRO 140 (3cr each), all three needing only ASTRO 1 (already selected) -- ASTRO 292 (the pool's fourth option) was skipped since it needs ASTRO 291, which itself needs PHYS 212, a real hidden-prereq chain not worth adding when three prereq-clean alternatives already fill the slot. ASTRO 401's own MATH 140 prereq is not listed as a separate minor requirement here since both verification majors (CMPSC and PLANET) already require MATH 140 on their own flowcharts -- merge_plans widens that existing item rather than needing a new one. Computed total: 4+3+3+3+3+3 = 19cr, an exact match to the bulletin's stated total, zero hidden-prereq additions against either verification major.
